name: Liberty Poley
residence: Buffalo, Johnson County (she wrote that she lives in the home she grew up in; 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
education: Bachelor's degrees in political science and history, University of the Cumberlands (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: In her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Liberty Poley wrote that she lives in the Buffalo home she grew up in, that aside from a few years in Campbell County for swim training she has lived in Buffalo, that she is a third-generation Wyoming resident and a second-generation native, and that she would be 22 on Election Day 2024.

She wrote that she is a graduate of the University of the Cumberlands with bachelor's degrees in political science and history, and that she was a Scholar All-American swimmer in college. She also wrote that she had served two terms as a Republican precinct woman in Johnson County since 2018 and had been elected as a delegate to the Republican National Convention.
